crossApp.name: reference-palette-distance
crossApp.detail: mean ΔE2000 from the reference's top colors to the template palette (reported, not gated)

notes: Overall: rc.2 fixes the biggest rc.1 problem. The 16px-grid face (NeoDunggeunmo) now renders with solid 2px stems in every app. Compare blog/home-desktop-dark.png 'Field Notes' and 'More posts', or dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png '186' and '99.94%', with the reference headline in reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png: it is the same bitmap voice, not a copy. Night ground, cream type, 4px windows with darker interiors, the dither header rule, h2 dither rules, hue top bars and bullets, block meters, the bevelled gold marker, one gold hard-shadow button per screen, and the grass ground strip with its dotted dirt edge (now with readable groundHi checker) are in all four apps, light and dark. What still separates it from the reference is scene craft: the dashboard world and the lights. Those are scored under signature.

rc.1 issues, checked one by one. (1) Type: fixed, see above. (2) Scene density: fixed for blog, commerce and settings. blog/drawings/home-d1.png is now a street of five buildings, a parcel truck, a mailbox, lamps and carts. commerce/drawings/home-d1.png has stalls, two shopfronts, signs, lamps, crates, barrels and a cart. settings/drawings/settings-profile-d1.png has benches, cabinets, a desk with a monitor, toolboxes and racks across the full width. The dashboard is only partly fixed (see signature). (3) Object shading and outlines: present on buildings, stalls and cabinets. (4) Ground strip: the checker now reads (groundHi #88cc44) and the dotted edge is there, and most sprites are 24 to 44px, but see signature. (5) Card marker: fixed. It hangs in the padding and titles are flush (commerce/state-card-hover-desktop-dark.png, blog/home-desktop-dark.png cards). (6) Dashboard hierarchy: fixed. 32px titles sit outside the panels on dither rules, panels carry a bullet and 12px caption, and the chart and activity panels share a height (dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png). (7) n-of-m meter: NOT fixed. dashboard/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-dark.png still shows 'Tasks 2 of 6 complete' as plain text, and the spec now asks for a block meter, so this is an agent mistake. (8) Frame budget: fixed. The article figure and the newsletter take thin frames, and billing has two 4px windows plus 2px panels. (9) Hero subject: fixed, a street rather than one house. (10) Chip with both marker and bullet: fixed ('▶ All' only). (11) Clipped mobile placeholder: fixed (dashboard/home-mobile-dark.png 'Search projects…'). (12) About page half-empty row: fixed (blog/about-desktop-dark.png, three author cards fill the rule). (13) Commerce had no bob: fixed, nc-bob is now in commerce shots.json. (14) Day clouds invisible: fixed, the cloud now has an underside (blog/motion/motion-m1.png). No regressions found.

Signature (3), dashboard world: dashboard/drawings/projects-apollo-migration-d1.png is a 256px banner. The sky takes the top 60%. The 'server yard' is a few 1-unit poles and cable lines, two 4-unit-wide racks, a dish, crates and two small cabinets, each 8 to 20 units tall and spread with wide gaps over flat bands. Next to the reference banner at the same scale (reference/illustrations/p2-i3.png and p2-i2.png: a row of conifers about 40% of the scene height, textured snow ground, clouds, a moon with a halo, a focal sprite with a sparkle), the yard reads as sticks on an empty field. dashboard/drawings/home-d1.png has the same props in the 96px strip, and the right third is bare ridge. Thin poles and cable lines count toward the 6 to 12 props but carry no mass.

Signature (3), lights: the code has `warm blink` and `cold blink` single units on props (dashboard src/components/pixel/scene.ts), but at size.unit 2px a single unit is a 2px dot that does not register at 1440. In commerce/home-desktop-dark.png the shopfront windows are dark and no lamp is lit. In settings/settings-profile-desktop-dark.png only the monitor reads as lit. In dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png no rack LED is visible. The reference's lights are 4×4px at its 4× hero (cabin windows, lamp, beacon in reference/illustrations/p1-i1.png), so they read as light sources. The 3-to-8-lights rule is met in code but not on screen. This is a spec gap: the light size is not scaled to the placement.

Signature (3), ground strip: dashboard/drawings/home-d2.png bunches its four sprites (crates, cable reel, rack, purple case) into about 210px in the middle of a 1150px band, and the purple case is about 16px tall, below the spec's 24px minimum. blog/drawings/home-d2.png puts a 1-unit-wide lamp pole (about 2px of mass) and a 26px mailbox next to each other. The reference strip (reference/components/p1-light-footer-1.png and the foot of p1-desktop-light.png) spreads 48px conifers and the coin toward the two edges. The settings and commerce strips are spread better.

Signature (3), marker in the contents list: blog/posts-shipping-a-design-system-desktop-dark.png shows 'On this page' with no marker on any item when the page opens. TableOfContents.tsx only sets aria-current after a heading scrolls under the header. The reference marks the first heading at load (reference/illustrations/p2-i3.png right column, '▶ 들어가며'). Placement passes otherwise: hero on the blog home; banners on the article, about, product detail and project detail; strips on the store, cart, dashboard and every settings section; vignettes in cart-desktop-dark.png and state-search-empty-desktop-dark.png; ground strip on every screen. Motion passes: everything is stepped, the blog nav marker blinks with nc-swap as allowed, the cloud drifts at steps(240), and reduced motion is clean (gates). The commerce product sprites (commerce/home-desktop-light.png) remain the best-crafted drawings in the run.

Cross-app consistency (4): the header, window, marker, chip, table and ground strip grammar is the same everywhere, and light and dark map identically. Two things drift. The header 'Animation on' and 'Pixel body on' switches are transparent text buttons in the blog (blog/home-desktop-dark.png) but tint-filled boxes in commerce, dashboard and settings (commerce/home-desktop-dark.png, settings/settings-profile-desktop-dark.png). The reference's switch is a transparent text tool button (reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png, '❚❚ 애니메이션 켬'). Ground-strip sprite placement also differs per app: spread, clustered, or left half.

Hierarchy (4): each screen leads with its scene window and h1, then KPIs or content, as in reference p1/p3. Small issue: on commerce/products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-dark.png the 'Details' h2 sits about 24px under the purchase window, so it reads as a caption of the window rather than a section.

Spacing (4): the 4px scale and 64px sections hold. Voids remain. commerce/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png: the 'Items' window is stretched to the checkout window's height and leaves about 200px of empty interior under the free-shipping meter. dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png: the bars stop about 110px above the bottom of the chart panel, because equal height was achieved by stretching the panel, not by sizing the chart.

Component states (4): designed throughout. Gold 4px focus ring (commerce/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png, around a danger-framed field). Card hover marker plus sel fill. Danger frames with pixel '!' icons and messages (settings/state-profile-errors-desktop-light.png). A dialog window with a title bar, framed close button and gold confirm (settings/state-plan-dialog-desktop-dark.png). Empty states as a vignette, one sentence and a framed button with the marker (blog/state-search-empty-desktop-dark.png, commerce/cart-desktop-dark.png). A disabled stepper ◀ on the product page. The current plan is marked with marker and gold frame. Deductions: the n-of-m meter is missing on project detail (agent mistake, see the rc.1 list), and the user menu (dashboard/state-user-menu-open-desktop-dark.png) opens with no highlighted option, so the marker menu is not visible in the capture.

Polish (4): no default-browser leftovers, and every radius and shadow is right. Small issues: the settings sidebar panel stops at the content height and leaves a ledge above the ground strip on every settings screen (settings/settings-profile-desktop-dark.png at about y=855, settings-security-desktop-dark.png at about y=1168), while the dashboard sidebar runs full height. The apps hide the ground svg's sideways overflow with `html,body{overflow-x:clip}` (dashboard base.css:31) instead of clipping the strip. The full-page captures show the overflow as extra width (dashboard/home-mobile-dark.png is 1830px wide). That is a known capture artifact and is not scored, but the spec's CSS causes it.

Not penalized (known harness gaps): the sticky header captured mid-page (blog/state-search-empty-desktop-dark.png), the scrim ending at about 900px in the dialog capture, page width in full-page captures, and no pending request, so loading states never appear.
Verdict arithmetic: 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 3 averages 3.86. Below the 4.0 bar, with no score under 3. The remaining gap is almost entirely scene craft on product screens plus two marker and meter misses.
promptFixes: Prop mass (signature, spec gap): in Pixel stage recipe step 3, add: 'Props in the middle row are at least 16 units tall and 4 units wide in a banner (10 units tall in a strip). The focal group in front is 24 to 40 units tall in a 128-unit banner. Poles, cables, antennas and other 1-unit-wide lines are details on a prop and do not count toward the 6 to 12 props. In a banner, the props and ridge fill the lower half: sky bands take at most 55% of the height.' Add to Verification: 'In each banner crop, the props' silhouettes must cover at least a third of the lower half.' Evidence: dashboard/drawings/projects-apollo-migration-d1.png vs reference/illustrations/p2-i3.png.

Readable lights (signature, spec gap): in recipe step 5, replace 'single units' with 'lights are 2×2 units at size.unit (strip, banner, vignette) and 1×1 at size.unitHero, so every light is at least 4 CSS px; lit windows and shop signs count, with at least 3 on props per scene.' Add to Verification: 'At 1440px, count the visibly lit points on props in the still frame: at least 3.' Evidence: commerce/home-desktop-dark.png (dark shopfronts), dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png (no visible rack LEDs) vs reference/illustrations/p1-i1.png.

Ground strip spread (signature): after 'Ground strip:' add 'Place the sprites in different quarters of the 720-unit svg, at least 120 units apart, and none in the central 160 units if the strip sits under a sidebar shell. Each sprite is 12 to 24 units tall and at least 6 units wide; a 1-unit pole is not a sprite.' Add `.ground{overflow-x:clip}` (or wrap the svg in an overflow-clipping element) to the CSS block and add to Never: 'clipping overflow on html or body'. Evidence: dashboard/drawings/home-d2.png, dashboard base.css:31.

n-of-m meter (states, agent mistake the spec already forbids): move it into rule 9: '... scores, quotas and n-of-m progress are block meters; "2 of 6 complete" as bare text is unfinished.' Add a Verification line: 'every count of the form n of m (tasks, steps, items toward a threshold) has a meter under it.' Evidence: dashboard/projects-apollo-migration-desktop-dark.png.

Contents-list marker (signature, spec gap): in the RPG marker Where line, add: 'A contents list always has one current item: before the reader scrolls, the first heading is current (aria-current="location"), so the marker is visible on load.' Evidence: blog/posts-shipping-a-design-system-desktop-dark.png vs reference/illustrations/p2-i3.png.

Header tool switches (consistency, spec gap): give the Animation and Pixel body switches one CSS rule in Navigation: `.tool{height:var(--size-control);padding-inline:var(--space-8);background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--color-text-secondary)}.tool:hover{background:var(--color-surface-hover);color:var(--color-text-primary)}`, with 'never tint-filled or framed'. Evidence: blog/home-desktop-dark.png vs commerce/home-desktop-dark.png and reference/screenshots/p1-desktop-light.png.

Equal-height voids (spacing): in Layout adaptation, after 'Panels or columns side by side share a height', add: 'by sizing the content (the chart fills the panel's free height; a summary window aligns to the top and the next block fills the column), never by stretching an empty window. No window interior has more than space.64 of empty space.' Evidence: commerce/state-checkout-errors-desktop-dark.png Items window, dashboard/home-desktop-dark.png chart panel.

Shell sidebar (polish): in Layout adaptation Shells, add: 'the sidebar panel runs from the header to the ground strip (min-height:100%; the shell grid stretches); it never ends partway down the page.' Evidence: settings/settings-profile-desktop-dark.png, settings-security-desktop-dark.png.

Section after a window (hierarchy): in Spacing, add: 'an h2 that follows a window or panel is space.48 to space.64 below it, never closer than space.40.' Evidence: commerce/products-canvas-field-tote-desktop-dark.png 'Details'.
